verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's official CLI documents uploading native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF) with `glitchtip-cli debug-files upload`, and a release note mentions minidump support. That covers iOS and native crashes, but ProGuard/R8 mapping upload for Android is never mentioned. Missing for 10: ProGuard mapping upload, documentation showing symbolication results (function names/lines) after upload, independent or hands-on corroboration.
